readiness.hed: A mild, mostly clear evening, with patchy fog returning after 4 a.m. and rain chances by Thursday.
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service forecast for Fredericksburg has temperatures easing to around 67 this afternoon under sunny skies, then a low around 51 tonight. Patchy fog develops after 4 a.m. and lingers until 9 a.m. Wednesday, which then turns mostly sunny with a high near 76. Thursday brings a slight chance of rain before 1 p.m. and a high near 77. Rain is likely Thursday night, at 60%, with a slight chance of thunderstorms. No active alerts were posted for the Fredericksburg point this afternoon.
